title: Porches and shared entrances
body: At Cream Corner Apartments, an intercom sits beside the glazed lobby doors under the canopy. A few streets over, the bungalow gets daylight through a row of small panes in its front door. We fitted separate street entrances to the two halves of Gable Duplex and used the same steel walk-up door at Lantern Flats.
